text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fall in!! Today's Disciplinary Committee meeting
is about 'Patrol Inspections for the Summer Walk'!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Before we head over there, we should scout out a similar facility to look for hazards and potential concerns!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And! This is my Trainer!
They'll be helping us out this time as a neutral advisor!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to working with you~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's great spirit!
—Alright, let's move out!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! The size might be different,
but it's still a leisure facility!
Let's take good notes for reference!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's gettin' pretty lively here!
The kids are runnin' all over the place, it's so full of—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, watch out!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry! Wait up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Are you okay!?
choice_data_list: Not at all. I was just surprised.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: —I see. When one gets too excited, they lose sight of their surroundings, don't they...

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, that could easily happen during the Summer Walk too.
Getting absorbed in taking photos, or caught up having fun with friends...
...Let's add that to our list of concerns."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll use this shopping mall
as a reference!
Is there any danger—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaah!
My ice cream! It fell on the floorrr!!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's why I told you
to sit down while you eat...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you okay?
Let me help you clean that up!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member C
text_block_list.text:
Eating and drinking while walking... I see,
that could indeed cause trouble
for those around me and the facilities.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: “—Alright then, let's list out the concerns that came up during today's inspection!”

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As visibility drops in the evening, it becomes dangerous.
To play it safe, I propose adding a new curfew rule from around 17:00.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
"I believe we should also prohibit eating while walking on the premises.
That is considering the impact on other visitors.
Furthermore, regarding setting a spending limit for students..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, more and more rule additions
addressing various concerns were brought up.
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too harsh?
Isn't that a little too harsh?

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member C
text_block_list.text: However, since this is an off-campus facility, I think having additional rules like this is necessary. Don't you agree, Bamboo-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm...
If we're thinking about everyone's safety, sure, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I feel like that's a bit too harsh as well...

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I get where you're coming from, but the Summer Walk is pointless if the participants aren't having fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Summer is also the time to reflect on spring's results
and charge full steam ahead toward autumn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's super hyped and focused
for the next match, sir!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It is precisely because of this time of year—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just for a moment during summer,
I want them to forget about all that pressure and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So, we won't be adding any
extra rules for this year's Summer Walk, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member C
text_block_list.text:
“Doing that, however, would mean
neglecting student safety...”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll make a video about the concerns that came up this time and let everyone know!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If we make it easy to check on their phones and let them know in advance, they'll be careful!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And even so, in the unlikely event that something happens—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Just call my name, osu!! I'll come flying to you anytime, anywhere, osu!!"

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-senpai...!!
You were thinking that far ahead?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carefully considering the significance of the event and making a precise judgment...
That is the ideal answer for a disciplinary committee chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, and also!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You guys are students too!
Make sure you enjoy the Summer Walk to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Patrols in moderation, vacation first—
that's how I'm gonna spend it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheers of joy erupted. Seeing the committee members' response, Bamboo Memory looked somewhat proud as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is no time to be impressed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"There's still a whole mountain of stuff to do, su!
I gotta keep these concerns in mind and make the video!"

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
I'll pull it off perfectly!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bamboo Memory's words,
everyone's enthusiasm began to boil over.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, we've got tons to do, chief.
This resort area is massive!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll hammer the map into my head,
not just the safety concerns!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's give it all we've got, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bamboo Memory's words,
everyone's enthusiasm began to boil over.
